integrity: Closed-form proof from stationary sandpile balance, tree Green kernel, rank-one perturbation and exact global optimization. Two complementary standalone exact rational verifiers supplied.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected undirected trees with a source leaf adjacent to the unique sink; uniform recurrent start and expected total nonsink topplings, not distribution or nonstationary starts. Historical priority provisional.
title: Sharp amplification of stationary sandpile topplings by one edge on a tree
